name: working-line-rate-off
description: Removes the tokens/sec meter from pi's live working line ("Blanching… · 18m06s · thinking 8m18s · ↑314k ↓26k ⚡31.6 tok/s") while keeping every other segment, including the ↑input ↓output counters. One purpose: no tok/s in the working line. pi-one-ui has no config key for the rate alone (its finest knob is components.workingLine.segments.tokens, which also deletes the counters), so this wraps pi's public ui.setWorkingIndicator/setWorkingMessage facade instead. Touches no upstream file.
